summary: Credits consumed from parent org after Dedicated migration; subaccount invoice shows full charge
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (SignalWave Labs) migrated a child organization (signalwave-research) to a Dedicated contract on 2026-03-01. After migration, usage for the child org during the billing period (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07) was metered correctly, but the applied credits and promotional balance were deducted from the parent org (signalwave-org) invoice instead of the child org. The child org invoice shows full charge; the parent shows a corresponding negative credit line.

Impact:
- Customer reports an unexpectedly high charge on the child org invoice (~$12,400) and a matching negative credit on the parent invoice.
- This affects their internal chargeback processes and requires immediate correction before month-end billing reconciliation.
- No service interruption; usage and throttling behavior unaffected.

Timeline:
- 2026-03-01: Dedicated migration completed (ticket INT-8802).
- 2026-03-05: SignalWave notices anomalous child invoice and opens this ticket.
- 2026-03-06: Support acknowledged and began triage.

Steps to reproduce / Observed behavior:
1) Navigate to Billing > Invoices for signalwave-research (child org): invoice INV-2026-03-07 shows full usage charge with no promotional credit applied.
2) Navigate to Billing > Invoices for signalwave-org (parent): invoice INV-2026-03-07 shows a large line item "Applied promotional credit - signalwave-research (migration)" of the same amount.
3) Audit logs show a single reconciliation job ran on 2026-03-01 attributed to account_id parent_org_id with a note "migrated_suborg_credit_adjustment".

Expected behavior:
Credits/promotional balances owned by the child org should be applied to the child org's invoice after migration; parent org should not receive a negative credit tied to child usage.

Logs / attachments / evidence:
- Billing export CSV: s3://redwood-billing-exports/2026/03/signalwave-march.csv (access provided to billing-op team).
- Audit trail excerpt included (see billing logs): action=reconcile invoice=INV-2026-03-07 target_org=parent_org_id note="migrated_suborg_credit_adjustment".
- Customer screenshot of both invoices attached as invoice_evidence.png in ticket.

Initial investigation notes:
- Triage: Billing reconciliation job ran with parent_org_id set as the tenant when handling post-migration credit pointers. Hypothesis: migration script that rewired promotional balances did not correctly update the tenancy field for credits created during the Dedicated onboarding flow.
- Metering records show usage entries correctly tagged to child org throughout the period. Token-level metering and model usage align with the child org invoice amounts.
- Billing ledgers show a credit entry of type PROMO applied to parent_org_id with reference to child org ID.

Customer request:
- Move the credited amount back to the child org invoice and issue a corrected invoice for signalwave-research. If immediate reissue is not possible, provide a statement of correction and a journal entry we can use for internal chargeback reconciliation.

Workaround / Mitigation asked by customer:
- Temporary manual journal entry from our side until invoices are reissued.

Next steps (assigned):
- Billing Ops to confirm whether the reconciliation job can be safely re-run scoped to the child org (assigned INT-8802).
- Engineering to review the migration script for tenancy attribution bug and produce a hotfix if needed (tag: billing-service/migration).
- Support to coordinate corrected invoice issuance and communication with SignalWave finance.

investigation_notes: Engineering confirmed a tenancy attribution bug in migration helper (edge case for dedicated child orgs). Billing Ops prepared a non-destructive repair flow that voids the misplaced credit on the parent ledger and creates a child-scoped credit with identical metadata. PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/4124. No changes to metering records required. Estimated risk: low; change is ledger-only and audit-preserving.
workaround: Billing Ops can provide a formal journal entry and statement of correction for SignalWave finance to use for immediate chargeback reconciliation until corrected invoices are reissued.
customer_communication: Support committed to sending a confirmation email with the repair timeline and attaching the journal entry once Billing Ops finalizes it. Next update planned for 2026-03-14.
